verdict.reading: NEW, SHARPER: arm A's mean (94.1, a lower bound) is BELOW the pooled mean of the 18 constant actions (111.7, exact), and per window arm A only beats 'pick one action and repeat it' on 1/4 windows (mean gap -17.6). Separately, 2 of 3 reported means are LOWER BOUNDS, not exact averages: ['arm A (dev, n=80)', 'C-fair (dev, n=80)'] each contain episodes that reached the 300-decision cap. The best-constant comparison has no survivals, so its mean is exact -- which means the report compares a lower bound against an exact value when it contrasts arm A with C-const-best. The direction of that comparison is therefore the worst case for arm A, and it still loses, so the conclusion survives; but the numbers must be labelled as bounds.
